title: Unit 10 - Are you an outdoors person?

parts.title: Listening Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question: Where will Joel and his family stay this year?
options: the hotel next to the river
the hotel in Great Woods
the hotel on top of the hill

items.question: How much do Daniella's walking boots cost on the website?
What time does the park close today?
What will they do in the afternoon?
options: build a tree house
go windsurfing
go mountain biking

items.question: Where are Dad's keys?
options: on the bag
on the ground
inside the car

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 1. Where will Joel and his family stay this year?

script.speaker: Joel
script.text: Dad, can we go to that hotel next to the river again this year?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Sorry, Joel. Your mother didn't like it very much.

script.speaker: Joel
script.text: How about that place on top of that hill? We stayed there two years ago.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: That's full, so <u>Mum and I found one in Great Woods</u>. I booked it last night.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 2. How much do Daniella's walking boots cost on the website?

script.speaker: Daniella
script.text: I saw some great new walking boots in town today but they were £120.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Oh, Daniella, why don't you look online? Your cousin bought some boots for £100.

script.speaker: Daniella
script.text: I looked at www.bestboots.com and <u>the cheapest ones were £130</u>.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Oh, really? Let's go and buy them from that shop in town then.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 3. What time does the park close today?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Excuse me. Do you know what time the park closes?

script.speaker: Man
script.text: The sign says it shuts at six thirty every day. Oh, except <u>Sunday when it closes at six</u>. That's today, isn't it?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Yes, that's right. What time is it now?

script.speaker: Man
script.text: Five thirty – so it's nearly time to go.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 4. What will they do in the afternoon?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: That was awesome! I've never been windsurfing on this lake before.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: I come here a lot. It's great, isn't it? Do you know what we're going to do next?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: My dad said that after lunch <u>we're going to build a tree house</u>.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Cool! And tomorrow we're going mountain biking. I love being outdoors in the school holidays!

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 5. Where are Dad's keys?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: I can't find my car keys. I thought I left them on that bag.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Look on the floor. Maybe you dropped them.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: They're not there. I think <u>they may still be inside the car</u>.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: I'll look ... You're right, Dad, here they are!

parts.title: Listening Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question: What was the weather like last winter?
options: snowy
rainy
icy

items.question: Who will go for the birthday meal with Jade and her parents?
options: Jade's two friends and her brother
Jade's two friends and another boy
Jade's two friends and another girl

items.question: What happened during the storm last week?
options: A tree fell across the road.
A tree fell on a building.
A tree fell near the road and the road flooded.

items.question: What does Eleanor do on the farm at weekends?
options: collects eggs
works in the farm shop
looks after horses

items.question: Where is Charlie's phone?
options: in the kitchen
in Mum's car
in the library

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 1. What was the weather like last winter?

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Look at the snow outside, Daisy!

script.speaker: Daisy
script.text: Wow! We can go skiing this weekend – brilliant! We didn't ski last winter at all, did we?

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: No, <u>it was too wet</u>. But there may be a lot of ice on the roads this weekend, so we may not go skiing.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 2. Who will go for the birthday meal with Jade and her parents?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Who's coming to the restaurant with us on your birthday, Jade?

script.speaker: Jade
script.text: I asked three of my best friends, Mary, Kate and Emma, but Emma can't come.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: OK ... and of course <u>your brother</u> will be with us.

script.speaker: Jade
script.text: Yes, and you and dad.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 3. What happened during the storm last week?

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: That storm was terrible last week, wasn't it?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Yes! <u>A tree fell across the river and the water came up onto the road</u> near our school.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Was the school OK?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Yes, but we had to walk there every morning until the water went away. Cars couldn't get to the school, but it was OK on foot.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 4. What does Eleanor do on the farm at weekends?

script.speaker: Eleanor
script.text: I usually go to my uncle's farm at weekends.

script.speaker: Man
script.text: Really? Where's the farm, Eleanor?

script.speaker: Eleanor
script.text: It's the one next to the horse-riding school.

script.speaker: Man
script.text: Cool! And you told me that he has lots of chickens – <u>do you collect their eggs</u>?

script.speaker: Eleanor
script.text: I do, and my friend Sue sells them in the farm shop. It's really good fun.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: 5. Where is Charlie's phone?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Why are you using my phone, Charlie?

script.speaker: Charlie
script.text: Because <u>mine's in Mum's car</u> and she's gone to see Grandma.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Are you sure? I saw it in the kitchen this morning.

script.speaker: Charlie
script.text: I know, but I went to the library after that. Mum drove me home, and she's just texted Dad to say she found it on one of the seats.
